scripts.worker: UV_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.pebble/uv-cache" uv run --project services/worker pebble-worker serve
scripts.worker:funasr: PEBBLE_PROVIDER=funasr UV_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.pebble/uv-cache" uv run --project services/worker --extra funasr pebble-worker serve
scripts.worker:doctor: UV_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.pebble/uv-cache" uv run --project services/worker pebble-worker doctor
scripts.worker:bench: UV_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.pebble/uv-cache" uv run --project services/worker --extra funasr pebble-worker bench
scripts.worker:models: UV_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.pebble/uv-cache" uv run --project services/worker pebble-worker models
scripts.test:worker: cd services/worker && export UV_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.pebble/uv-cache" && uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
